vertical_alignment: ALL ROAD TRIANGLES AT Z=+100 CM. UNSURVEYED. DO NOT USE AS FINAL GROUND OR BRIDGE ELEVATION.
caveats: This is a polygon union of estimated-width road buffers, not engineered street centerline junction topology.
A fused polygon can bridge very close roads. Check intersections against imagery and source GIS.
Fused surface parts may remain disconnected because the input source is incomplete or gaps exist.
No sidewalks, buildings, terrain, vehicle pawn, bridge separations, or verified physics material.
Amtrak rail features excluded, do not substitute rail corridors for streets.
No vertical information: not suitable for grade-separated roads/highways.
